bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
r=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/.releases/807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf/video-production-compat
test -s "$r/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs" && test ! -e "$r/Dockerfile" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
export GACE_VIDEO_ROOT="$r"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(os.environ['GACE_VIDEO_ROOT'])
p=root/'src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs'
w=p.read_text()
if "const nextScreen=error?old.screen:firstVideo?'description':'editor';" not in w:sys.exit(81)
if "waiting:error?old.waiting:firstVideo?'description':null," not in w:sys.exit(82)
if 'creatorDescriptionPanel' not in w:sys.exit(83)
rx=r"(?<!\w)statusPanel\(\s*draft\s*,\s*rev\s*,\s*note\s*,\s*nextScreen\s*\)"
if "nextScreen==='description'\n" not in w:
 replacement="nextScreen==='description' ? creatorDescriptionPanel(draft,rev,note) : statusPanel(draft,rev,note,nextScreen)"
 w,n=re.subn(rx,lambda m:replacement,w)
 if n!=1:sys.exit(84)
p.write_text(w)
print('VIDEO_DESCRIPTION_RENDER_COMPAT=PASS')
PY
old=create-videobot:pre-video-description-807cea97
new=create-videobot:video-description-807cea97-tested
test -z "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 63
docker tag create-videobot:local-poll "$old" || exit 64
{ echo "FROM $old";echo 'USER root';for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs;do echo "COPY --chown=node:node $p /opt/videobot/$p";done;echo 'USER node';} > "$r/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new" "$r" >/dev/null || exit 65
for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs;do
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check "/opt/videobot/$p" || exit 66
done
if ! docker run --rm --network none -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs > "$r/test-results.log" 2>&1;then
 echo VIDEO_COMPAT_TEST=FAIL
 grep -E '^not ok |^# pass |^# fail ' "$r/test-results.log" | head -n 25 || true
 exit 67
fi
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 68
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 69
echo VIDEO_COMPAT_IMAGE=TEST_PASS
echo VIDEO_RUNTIME_CHANGED=NO
